summary: Selects the current sprite frame value for a frame-info output struct. In single-frame mode (animation mode at this+0x120 is 1 or less) the frame is picked from a sprite frame data array at this+0x124 based on whether the animation position at this+0x80 has reached the limit at this+0x118; otherwise the frame value is pinned to 1. The two output fields at this+0x198 and this+0x19C are zeroed unconditionally. Called by CompositingPass and CompositingCopy.

operations.description: Load the output frame-info struct pointer from this+0x184 into result; all later writes target its fields.
Branch on the animation mode at this+0x120: when <= 1 use the frame-selection logic, otherwise force the frame value to 1.
Compute whether the animation position at this+0x80 is below (limit - 1), where the limit is read from this+0x118.
Pick the frame value from the sprite frame data array at this+0x124: from +0xC when the position is below the limit, otherwise from +0x48.
Write the selected frame value (or the pinned value 1 in the else branch) to the output field at this+0x1A0.
Zero the two remaining output fields at this+0x198 and this+0x19C.
Return the output frame-info struct pointer.

unresolved: The exact meaning of the array picks at this+0x124 + 12 and + 72 (frame versus end marker) is inferred from control-flow position; not independently verified.
The unconditional zeroing of this+0x198 / this+0x19C and their consumer semantics are unknown.
Fields this+0x130 and this+0x16C are present in the layout but not referenced by the raw function body.
